overview: Gluco Fit is a comprehensive diabetes and health management web application. It helps users track glucose levels, log diet and calories, book doctor appointments, manage treatment plans, shop for diabetes-related products, and follow exercise sessions — all in one place.
features: Shopping for diabetes foods, medicines, and equipment
Exercise sessions with YouTube video integration
User dashboard aggregating all health data
Admin dashboard monitoring all user activity
Role-based access for users and admins
